newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Banco Nacion lowers lending rates.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Banco Nacion lowers lending rates.

text.p: Argentina's Banco de la Nacion said Friday it lowered its rates by around three percentage points on both peso and dollar loans.
Peso loans were lowered to 14.11 percent from 17.03 percent, while the cost of a dollar loan fell to 12 percent from 15 percent.
The state-owned Banco de la Nacion, Argentina's largest lender, said this was the second lending-rate cut this year.
Time deposits remained unchanged, with 30-day peso fixed-rate deposits yielding 7.17 percent. Dollar time deposits for 30-days are returning 5.80 percent.
